evidence.quote: Search this site Embedded Files Courtney Lab at UCSD Courtney Lab The Courtney Lab has an active research program in the clinical neuroscience of substance addiction. Our research focuses on understanding the neurobiological mechanisms that drive the development and maintenance of addiction by studying characteristics such as craving and impulsivity. Through this work , we hope to develop new ways to intervene and treat substance addiction. In our studies, we use a number of laboratory methods including neuroimaging (e.g., fMRI, EEG, fNIRS), cognitive, and behavioral assessments. Projects Varenicline VR Study (CURRENTLY RUNNING) The Varen VR Study is being conducted to explore biological markers of nicotine craving during a virtual reality (VR) experience in adults (22+) who smoke cigarettes daily. Learn more about this study. NicAdmin Study (CURRENTLY RUNNING) The NicAdmin Study is being conducted to better understand how the brain responds to nicotine in young adults.
